title: Honey Never Spoils - Not Even After 3,000 Years
caption:
This honey is 3,000 years old - and still perfectly edible.
Xiao Bai finds a 3,000-year-old honey jar in an ancient tomb and takes a spoonful, expecting it to be rotten.
Pure honey never spoils: its low water and high acidity create a bacteria dead zone that kills germs.
Would you taste honey that's 3,000 years old?
Save this fact and share it with the friend who hoards snacks.
